snippet.title: Mad Father Remake Switch Trailer
snippet.description:
Mad Father Remake:
Release 11/05/2020!
 
In addition to updates such as a total revamping of the in-game graphics, this remake adds brand new scenes and “Blood Mode” – a new second playthrough which alters the story.
